text:
Erin: kicking off deployment window 03:00 UTC for api/runtime/console/router. cross-service coordination thread. short checks + rollback criteria listed here.

Ben: runtime image tagged `v2.3.4` ready. pinned on dedicated. I've uploaded the rollout playbook to /releases. No pending hotfix.

Carla: console requires schema migration `migrate-ui-2026-03`. plan: canary 5% (15m) -> 50% (15m) -> 100%. final step will need brief read-only ~2m.

Dave: router change `header-split` adds x-rw-route header; affects edge timers. propose regional stagger, 10m drain per region. I ran local sim, saw minor p95 bump.

Alice: FYI there's a runtime flag `kv.eviction` that could evict session cache on flip. Ben, confirm canary vs prod settings.

Ben: confirmed: canaries have `kv.eviction=false`, prod remains `true` until after canary. I'll run small mem-pressure smoke during canary.

deploy-bot: deploy request accepted. CI green. window locked 03:00-03:45 UTC. canary window 15m.

Erin: proposed go/no-go rules: api/runtime health OK in canary; console migration applies without errors on canaries; router metrics (5xx, p95, p50) within thresholds. Rollback if any fail or error budget >1%.

Dave: add router-specific trigger: roll back router if 5xx >0.5% over 5m OR p95 increases >100ms sustained for 5m.

Ben: api trigger: rollback runtime if p50 increases >200ms over 5m or error rate >0.5% in canary. runtime rollback cmd: `redwood deploy rollback runtime --to v2.3.3 --force-health-checks`. I'll run it if needed.

Carla: console rollback: `redwood console migrate rollback --to previous` but expect ~3m downtime. prefer avoid unless migration fails on canary hosts.

Erin: ownership: ben = runtime, carla = console migration, dave = router. alice monitors flags and long-tail probes. I'll prep release notes & support ping.

Alice: running long-tail smoke 10x pre-canary: `curl -sS -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"<long tail>"}'`. Posting results if anything odd.

deploy-bot: preflight results: quotas ok, infra healthy, autoscale targets met, no active incidents. ETA 7m.

Ben: starting runtime canary -> 5%. image `runtime:v2.3.4-canary-1`. watching p50/p95 and mem.

(5m later)

Ben: canary p50 stable, mem +3% within tolerance. no errors.

Carla: console canary migration applied, no schema errors on canary nodes. rolling to 50% in 2m.

Dave: router header-split applied to eu-west first. shifting 10% traffic, observing edge timers.

(10m later)

Dave: eu-west p95 rose ~120ms for ~3m during background reassign, trending down. holding and watching 5m.

Erin: decision?

Ben: recommend pausing global router rollout until eu-west stabilizes. runtime can continue to 50% but hold 100%.

Carla: pausing console 50% -> hold on final 100% migration.

Dave: agree. will rollback eu-west router change if another spike >100ms p95 appears for 10m.

(hold period)

Ben: advanced runtime to 50% internal workers, not fronting external traffic to prevent client impact.

Erin: consolidated plan:
- Router: hold global rollout until eu-west stable +10m monitoring
- Console: pause at 50% canary, delay final migration
- Runtime: progress to 50% then await router green for 100%
- Rollback triggers: router 5xx >0.5% OR p95 delta >100ms sustained 5m; api p50 delta >200ms 5m; console migration errors >0
- Rollback owners: ben runtime, dave router, carla console

deploy-bot: lock extended to 04:15 UTC if team needs extra time. noted triggers and owners.

Erin: i'll update release notes, ping #support and #customer-updates after final state. :thumbsup:

Alice: ack - continuing long-tail probes.

Ben: ack - standing by to rollback if necessary.

Carla: ack - ready with rollback steps.

Dave: ack - prepping rollback runbook and pre-staging route configs.

deploy-bot: thread closed by deploy-bot (status: active window, locks set).
